name: gate_map
description: Privilege-door map for any locked bird: root check, bootloader/AVB state, OEM unlock state, credential artifact reachability (locksettings/spblob/gatekeeper/weaver), partition table, crypto type, trust agents, strong-auth flags. Run after recon ladder on any gate mission.

args.command: id; which su 2>&1; su -c id 2>&1; getprop ro.crypto.type; getprop ro.crypto.state

getprop ro.boot.flash.locked; getprop ro.boot.vbmeta.device_state; getprop ro.boot.verifiedbootstate; getprop sys.oem_unlock_allowed; getprop ro.boot.warranty_bit; getprop ro.board.platform; getprop ro.build.version.security_patch
dumpsys trust 2>/dev/null | head -12; dumpsys account 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'Account \{' | head -20
